declaration: After primary-source method review and existing figure QA, before any MeSH fits in this assessment; not blinded or independent preregistration
source_normalization: Line endings only for hash portability; numeric data unchanged; existing CSV not rewritten
source_version: arXiv:2504.01102v1, draft PDF; not publisher final layout
reference_role: TST-conditioned multi-experiment recommendation; not identical estimand to unconstrained single-trace apparent leading-edge or ideal whole-peak energy
absolute_TST_comparison: Withheld: numerical y axis in 10^15 molecules/K does not alone establish surface-area/ML conversion, full processing and original calibration; no absolute nuisance amplitude is invented
source_temperature_accuracy: Paper reports about 2 K absolute and +/-0.1 K relative; pixel allowance is not the experimental temperature uncertainty
pixel_sensitivity: Four primary zero-baseline corners: T +/- existing 1.5px axis allowance; signal +/- existing stroke/threshold bounds; selected columns retained by shifting interval too; nonpositive points counted and excluded by production routine
input_screen: At least five positive finite leading pairs; at least30 finite full-peak pairs, strictly increasing T; no smoothing, sorting, gap interpolation or reconstructed time
weights: Uniform per recovered raster column; correlated pixels; no statistical CI/MC interpretation
stopping_rule: 4 leading-edge, 4 whole-peak, 4 engineering perturbation cases; retain exceptions/rejections. No interval tuning, extra curves or MC to improve agreement.
